summary: All three previously missing canonical definition bodies are now present locally with saved response and source hashes. FixedDeterminantFamily is a manual source transcription over 33 original definitions, but it still lacks independent kernel and AST equality checks and therefore is not approved for reuse. FormalInterpolationPackets is an adapted interface rather than a same-name source module. AnalyticRemainder replaces the source's floor-valued translation count by a real polynomial envelope and is not the source definition. The fastest root route can avoid all three community adapter leaves: reuse only the already validated six Statement definitions, generate an isolated source proof closure, give fresh Source017 names to the three proved platform theorems that collide inside that closure, and submit the final proof to the existing open pi_eventual_lower_bound target before applying the small UpperBound transfer.

validated_existing_reuse.scope: Only these six Statement definitions. No conclusion here extends to FixedDeterminantFamily, FormalInterpolationPackets or AnalyticRemainder.

interfaces.finding: The canonical file collects the same named signatures and right-hand-side formulas visible in the pinned source for these 33 definitions, while changing imports and file/namespace assembly. That makes it a strong reuse candidate, not a validated reuse. Its dependency on the separately published AdmissibleDeterminantParameters module, universe elaboration, implicit arguments, reducibility, values and scope have not been independently compared against the source environment.
interfaces.collision: Importing this canonical module together with independently generated original-name source definitions produces duplicate constants across all 33 names.
blocking_checks: independent kernel type and value equality for all 33 declarations and their canonical prerequisites

authoritative_source_owners.name: OAI.PiExponent.FormalLogJet.liftSeries
authoritative_source_owners.difference: The source is polymorphic over a CommRing R; the canonical declaration is specialized to Complex and moved to FormalInterpolation.

authoritative_source_owners.name: OAI.PiExponent.FormalLogJet.formalJet
authoritative_source_owners.difference: The canonical formula expands the source formalLog helper and moves the declaration to a new namespace; equality has not been elaboration-checked.

authoritative_source_owners.name: OAI.PiExponent.WeightedSliceDegree.SupportBound
authoritative_source_owners.difference: WeightedPolynomial packages a direct support inequality with arbitrary matrix weights and height; it is not the same source declaration.

authoritative_source_owners.name: OAI.PiExponent.AdmissibleMatrixInterpolation.WeightedPolynomials
authoritative_source_owners.difference: The source family is indexed by fixed data d and n and uses curveDegreeWeights with n times scale radius; the canonical family is indexed by w0, w and real H.

authoritative_source_owners.name: OAI.PiExponent.AdmissibleMatrixInterpolation.packetMap
authoritative_source_owners.difference: The source map returns Fin d.K to RationalCoefficientPacket at rational height; the canonical adapter returns DeterminantContradiction.Row d H to Complex at real height.

interfaces.finding: No OAI.PiExponent.FormalInterpolation declaration occurs in the authoritative source declaration graph. The module deliberately adapts source formulas to community leaf statements. It is not needed by the original source proof closure and cannot be treated as direct source reuse.

authoritative_source_owners.name: OAI.PiExponent.LiteralAnalytic.analyticRemainder
authoritative_source_owners.source_formula: Collision.collisionRemainder (actualRowCount d H) H + log (translationTermCount d.m d.v0 H) / H

interfaces.canonical_difference: translationEnvelope is the real polynomial (H+1)^(2*m) * (H/v+1), and the canonical analyticRemainder uses log translationEnvelope instead of log of the source natural-floor translationTermCount. It also lives in DeterminantContradiction rather than LiteralAnalytic and inlines collisionRatio as exp (-log 2 / 2).
interfaces.finding: For positive H and v the envelope is intended to majorize the source count, but the canonical body contains only definitions and no theorem establishing that inequality. The canonical value is not definitionally the source value and is not used by the original source analytic proof.

fast_root_integration.reason: The authoritative source pi_eventual_lower_bound has value dependencies only on piEventualLowerBound_of_globalInterpolation and AdmissibleMatrixInterpolation.globalInterpolation. The three community leaves belong to an adapted campaign decomposition and do not occur in the original source declaration closure. The local UpperBound transfer consumes only OAI.PiExponent.pi_eventual_lower_bound plus PiIrrationality.UpperBound.
